## Goal

Describe the outcome in one or two sentences.
Example: *"Collect a sample dataset of at least 40 product reviews that includes sarcasm, mixed opinions and non-English text."*

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change works on `data/sample_reviews.csv`
- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] README or `docs/` updated where relevant

## Area

One of: Dataset Collection · Model Development · Testing · Documentation · Deployment

## Notes

Files involved, links, or open questions. Example: *`review_analyzer/preprocessing.py`, `data/`*
